tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Use this to identify the connected wariwari account.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this first when the user names a group, a person or an expense without its token. Searches every group the user belongs to by group name, member name, expense description or category, or by an exact amount ("7000", "¥7,000", "12.50") or ISO date ("2026-05-22"). A blank query returns the most rec

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: Use this to list the user's groups with their tokens and currencies. Pass archived=true for archived groups.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Use this for who is in a group and who owes whom. Returns members with their tokens, each member's net balance per currency (positive = is owed, negative = owes), and the suggested payments that settle up. Expenses are not included; use list_transactions for those.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Use this to list a group's expenses and payments, newest first, optionally filtered by date range, category or participant token. Page with cursor.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Use this to read one expense or payment in full, including its splits and lockVersion.

tools.name: get_group_stats
tools.description: Use this for spending totals, per-category and per-member breakdowns, the largest expenses and spending over time. Amounts are minor units in the group currency.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Use this to start a new group. List the other members by name: the user is added as a member under their account name, or linked to the member already named like it. Pick an emoji icon that fits the group, and ask which currency it settles in when the user hasn't said. Read the new group with get_gr

tools.name: add_member
tools.description: Use this to add a person to a group by name.

tools.name: add_expense
tools.description: Use this to record an expense. amountCents is in minor units of currency (¥1,000 is 1000, $12.50 is 1250). paidByParticipantToken is who paid; splits lists who shares it. For an even split use splitType equal and omit amountCents from the splits. Take participant tokens from get_group or search, and

tools.name: update_expense
tools.description: Use this to change an expense. Send only the fields that change; expectedRevision is the lockVersion from get_transaction, and a stale one means someone else edited it, so read it again first. A new amountCents re-divides an equal split; for any other split type, send splits with the new amounts too

tools.name: delete_expense
tools.description: Use this to delete an expense or payment. expectedRevision is the lockVersion from get_transaction.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Use this when one member paid another back. fromParticipantToken paid toParticipantToken amountCents, in minor units. get_group's suggested payments say who should pay whom to settle up.

tools.name: update_payment
tools.description: Use this to change a payment. Send only the fields that change, plus the lockVersion from get_transaction as expectedRevision.

tools.name: bulk_edit_expenses
tools.description: Use this to set the same payer, category, split, date or time on several expenses at once. List each one in transactions with its token and, as expectedRevision, its lockVersion from list_transactions.

tools.name: bulk_delete_expenses
tools.description: Use this to delete several expenses or payments at once. List each one in transactions with its token and, as expectedRevision, its lockVersion from list_transactions.

tools.name: get_expense_history
tools.description: Use this to see who created or changed one expense or payment, and what changed, newest first.

tools.name: get_group_history
tools.description: Use this to see recent changes to a group's expenses and payments, newest first. Page with cursor.

tools.name: get_member_balance
tools.description: Use this to explain why a member owes or is owed: their balance in the group currency, expense by expense. Entries name transactions by token.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Use this to rename a group, change its icon or currency, or change who can open it by link (visibility: public_editable, public_view_only, or private_registered for members only). A new currency converts existing expenses in the background, so read an expense again before editing it. expectedRevisio

tools.name: duplicate_group
tools.description: Use this to start a new group with the same categories, and the same members unless includeMembers is false. Expenses are not copied.

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Use this to delete a group for everyone in it. expectedRevision is the group's lockVersion from get_group. To only take it off the user's own list, use archive_group or leave_group instead.

tools.name: leave_group
tools.description: Use this to remove a group from the user's list and unlink them from their member, which stays as a guest. The group and its expenses stay for everyone else. The last admin of a private or view-only group can't leave.

tools.name: get_notification_settings
tools.description: Use this to check whether the user has muted push notifications for a group.

tools.name: update_notification_settings
tools.description: Use this to mute or unmute push notifications for a group, for the user only.

tools.name: archive_group
tools.description: Use this to hide a group from the user's group list. Only the user's own list changes.

tools.name: unarchive_group
tools.description: Use this to bring an archived group back to the user's group list.

tools.name: update_member
tools.description: Use this to rename a guest or change their colour, or to change the role (admin, editor, read_only) of a member linked to an account. expectedRevision is the member's lockVersion from get_group.

tools.name: move_member
tools.description: Use this to move a member to a position in the group's member list, or one step up or down.

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: Use this to remove a member from a group. expectedRevision is the member's lockVersion from get_group.

tools.name: merge_members
tools.description: Use this when two members are the same person. participantToken is the duplicate: their expenses and payments move to intoParticipantToken and the duplicate is removed. expectedRevision is the duplicate's lockVersion from get_group. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: claim_member
tools.description: Use this when the user says they are one of a group's members, to link that member to their account. If the user is already linked to another member, the two are merged.

tools.name: add_category
tools.description: Use this to add an expense category to a group, with an emoji and a name.

tools.name: update_category
tools.description: Use this to rename a category, change its emoji or move it. expectedRevision is the category's lockVersion from get_group.

tools.name: delete_category
tools.description: Use this to delete a category no expense uses. expectedRevision is the category's lockVersion from get_group.

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.description: Use this to list a group's invitation links that can still be used. Admins only.

tools.name: create_invitation
tools.description: Use this to create an invitation link to a view-only or private group, as an admin, editor or read_only member, and give the user its url to share. A public_editable group needs no invitation: share its shareUrl from get_group, or make it private first with update_group. Admins only.

tools.name: revoke_invitation
tools.description: Use this to cancel an invitation link, by its token from list_invitations. Admins only.

tools.name: list_access_requests
tools.description: Use this to see who has asked to join a view-only or private group. Admins only.

tools.name: approve_access_request
tools.description: Use this to let someone who asked to join a group in as an editor. Admins only.

tools.name: decline_access_request
tools.description: Use this to turn down a request to join a group. The person can ask again after 7 days. Admins only.

tools.name: export_csv
tools.description: Use this to get every expense and payment in a group as CSV text, the same file the web app exports.

tools.name: get_fx_rate
tools.description: Use this to convert from another currency into the group currency, optionally on a past date.

tools.name: list_recurring_expenses
tools.description: Use this to list the expenses a group repeats on a schedule, with each one's next date. A paused schedule was set up by someone who no longer has Pro: its dates are skipped until they have it again.

tools.name: create_recurring_expense
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an expense added on a schedule, such as monthly rent. It is posted on startsOn and then every interval weeks, months or years; a startsOn in the past begins at the next date from today.

tools.name: delete_recurring_expense
tools.description: Use this to stop a schedule, by its token from list_recurring_expenses. Expenses it already added stay.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_notification_settings, create_invitation · Private data: search, list_groups, get_group, list_transactions, create_group, add_expense, record_payment, bulk_edit_expenses, bulk_delete_expenses, get_member_balance, leave_group, create_invitation, revoke_invitation, list_access_requests, export_csv, delete_recurring_expense · Public sink: update_expense, update_payment, create_invitation · Destructive: delete_expense, bulk_delete_expenses, delete_group, leave_group, remove_member, delete_category, delete_recurring_expense.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_notification_settings, create_invitation · Private data: search, list_groups, get_group, list_transactions, create_group, add_expense, record_payment, bulk_edit_expenses, bulk_delete_expenses, get_member_balance, leave_group, create_invitation, revoke_invitation, list_access_requests, export_csv, delete_recurring_expense · Public sink: update_expense, update_payment, create_invitation · Destructive: delete_expense, bulk_delete_expenses, delete_group, leave_group, remove_member, delete_category, delete_recurring_expense

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
